source.experiment_base_subject: docs: record shared-A Gate Up rejection
source.test_only_source_subject: test: screen split-M64 FP8 QKV prefill

post_measurement_harness_hardening.subject: test: harden split-M64 FP8 screen
post_measurement_harness_hardening.scope: always end a successfully started Graph capture, require exactly 512 classified NaN outputs, and distinguish unchanged global A/B traffic from increased shared-B fragment reads; candidate kernel code is unchanged
post_measurement_harness_hardening.validation_result: resource, invalid-call, Graph, direct/replay exactness, E4M3FN, classified-NaN, guard, immutable-input, build, and CTest gates pass

source.retention: retain the isolated BUILD_TESTING target and test-only direct launcher as reproducible negative evidence; do not admit the split-M64 route to production

environment.claim_scope: one fixed-clock Orin, one deterministic checkpoint-like exact-C512 QKV validation fixture, and one six-round isolated eager timing process

experiment.role: compare the public production FP8 whole-chunk M128 QKV kernel with one test-only 512-thread implementation that splits each resident M128 token tile across two M64 warp groups

baseline.name: public production FP8 M128xN128 whole-chunk QKV kernel

candidate.name: test-only FP8 QKV M128 split-M64 warp-group kernel
candidate.mapping: one 512-thread CTA retains production M128xN128 ownership; two independent 256-thread groups each own M64 tokens, share one cooperatively loaded M128 activation tile and one decoded B tile, retain four ordered M16 accumulators per warp, and drain through separate C buffers

selection_gates.first_cell: strict C512 QKV [10240,5120] with deterministic checkpoint-like E4M3FN weights
selection_gates.stop_loss: failure ends this candidate before profiling, whole-model work, or production integration

correctness.fixture: deterministic checkpoint-like canonical E4M3FN weights at scalar scale 0.00100708 and BF16 activations

protocol.timing_boundary: CUDA events on the single stream around 24 eager launches

artifact.expected_exit: nonzero solely because all six per-round performance gates and the aggregate performance gate fail after resource, invalid-call, Graph, exactness, replay, NaN-class/sign, guard, and immutable-input gates pass

static_sass.scope: production and split-M64 candidate function blocks in the measured binary
static_sass.thread_topology_note: the candidate function uses 512 threads instead of 256; its roughly halved per-thread static instruction and HMMA body does not imply halved CTA work or traffic

operand_traffic_observation.shared_B_fragment_reads: doubled because both M64 warp groups load the same B fragment that production loads once and reuses across eight A panels

static_sass.causal_limit: static SASS counts are structural evidence only; candidate NCU and Nsys were intentionally skipped after the frozen first-cell stop-loss

stop_loss_and_skipped_work.trigger: aggregate speedup is 0.936190 against the required 1.20x, every round is below the required 1.15x, and all six rounds regress below 1.0x

decision.result: reject production integration and close this exact 512-thread M128 split-M64 QKV mapping
decision.reason: reducing per-thread accumulator pressure while doubling CTA width and preserving the same M128xN128 ownership does not improve this C512 QKV cell; the candidate is 6.38 percent slower. Source topology shows doubled shared-B fragment reads and a wider synchronization domain, but no profiler-based causal attribution is made
closed_scope: the exact-C512 [10240,5120] 512-thread two-M64-warp-group implementation recorded here
further tuning that retains the same shared-A/shared-B split-M64 CTA structure without a materially different traffic or synchronization mechanism

next_priority.selection_rule: choose a materially different bounded candidate that reduces measured global/shared traffic or a kernel boundary rather than only repartitioning unchanged M128 arithmetic across more threads
next_priority.parallel_work: continue the bounded OpenAI-compatible API and EvalScope path without delaying the next kernel screen

reproduction.environment_requirement: run under MAXN on CPU 0 with GPU 1300500000 Hz and EMC 3200000000 Hz read back before accepting timings

limitations: The payload is deterministic and checkpoint-like rather than loaded checkpoint QKV tensor bytes.
Only the isolated exact-C512 QKV cell was admitted; no C256, whole-layer, whole-model, API, or EvalScope performance follows.
No candidate NCU or Nsys capture was run, so the regression is not attributed to a measured traffic, stall, cache, or synchronization cause.
The result closes this exact split-M64 mapping, not every possible FP8 QKV/Z/O dataflow or wider Prefill optimization.
